sources.dashboard_api_note: The stable dashboard documentation also lists MCP management; dashboard auth/port/profile contract is distinct from the API-server bearer interface.

findings.title: An in-flight run control can move to a different connection
findings.trigger: Hold the status read for an unknown-run acknowledgement on A, save/test connection B, then release the A response.
findings.observed: The resolve-unknown POST goes to B with B credentials but A run/admission identity; a subsequent B status response is written into the A conversation. The probe uses cloned run identities, representing overlapping/cloned deployments. No A bearer token is sent to B.
findings.expected: The complete operation stays bound to the original immutable connection/profile and receipt identity; unrelated connection changes cannot redirect it.
findings.fix: Pin connection/client/scope for the whole operation, gate connection changes while controls are busy, and reject stale asynchronous context writes. Audit all select/detail/reconcile paths under the same rule.

findings.title: Compatibility-mode follow-up requests lose assistant history
findings.trigger: Complete one OpenAI-compatible streaming answer, then send a follow-up referring to that answer.
findings.observed: The assistant answer is saved with response_finished, but the next HTTP request includes only the two user messages. The history filter retains assistant rows only when their status is completed.
findings.expected: A completed response remains eligible for conversational context without treating response completion as proof of server tool/run completion.
findings.fix: Separate response/history eligibility from authoritative execution outcome. Preserve completed and policy-approved partial assistant text; test wire history over multiple compatibility turns.

findings.title: A delayed SSE prompt resets protected decision states
findings.trigger: Persist an unknown or resolved control, then save a delayed stream update containing that same prompt.
findings.observed: saveTurn unconditionally upserts the incoming pending row. Both unknown and resolved states become pending. replaceControls has protective merge logic, but the SSE path bypasses it.
findings.expected: GET snapshots and SSE events share a transactional, generation-aware monotonic state merge.
findings.fix: Centralize control merging; preserve unknown/responding/resolved for the same generation except an explicitly authorized refresh transition. Retain exact server verification before decisions. This probe does not establish a server-side approval bypass.

findings.title: Job prompt validation exceeds the upstream REST limit
findings.trigger: Review/create a job with a 6000-character ASCII prompt.
findings.observed: The mobile validator accepts it; both pinned upstream API implementations limit cron prompts to 5000. A matching HTTP-400 fixture causes an unknown receipt that blocks subsequent mutations pending human review.
findings.expected: Known supported limits are enforced before submission; documented definite pre-admission refusals are distinguishable from ambiguous delivery.
findings.fix: Use the supported 5000-character contract unless a future negotiated limit says otherwise, provide localized validation feedback, and preserve structured refusal codes/Retry-After. Do not classify every arbitrary HTTP 400 as proof of no mutation.

feature_matrix.required_work: Create/list/history/rename/delete, run submission/events/status/stop and explicit controls exist; live deployment validation remains open.

feature_matrix.feature: Model/provider picker and session model lock
feature_matrix.required_work: GET /api/model/options and session /model plus model/provider/model_options request fields. Persist the exact chosen request for replay and show server lock/effective route.
GET /v1/skills. Requesting a skill through reviewed input is distinct from installing it or emulating CLI slash commands.
Hub/catalog and curator operations require the dashboard auth/profile contract, not guessed bearer endpoints.
GET /v1/toolsets and /health/detailed. Show enabled/configured status; toolsets alone are not a complete MCP connection registry.

feature_matrix.mobile_status: Can be used indirectly when configured
feature_matrix.required_work: Do not add a second agent or individual provider SDKs on the phone. Configured server tools can already run through chat; verify representative tools live.
/api/mcp/servers and catalog use dashboard auth. Define secure native login/session handling, explicit target profile and permissions before writes.

feature_matrix.feature: MCP sampling, form elicitation and trust
feature_matrix.required_work: Generic once/deny can carry supported form-consent; validate real MCP trust/cost/elicitation cases. URL-mode elicitation is unsupported upstream and should not be advertised as a mobile gap alone.

feature_matrix.mobile_status: Provider execution inherited; setup/status UI missing
feature_matrix.required_work: Portal-backed tools/models can work already. Mobile has no subscription state, provider fallback visibility or key-pool administration. Keep provider secrets server-side.
POST session /fork and GET session detail. Preserve lineage, current continuation and unknown-run safety.
POST run /steer is supported. Current Send is blocked while busy and decoder flattens queued to running; distinguish steer from another turn or stop.
Persist tool_call_id; pair concurrent start/completion events; render subagent.start/complete, child identity and supplied bounded summaries. Do not equate tool success with run completion.
Token/cache/cost fields are not persisted or displayed. Label estimates and absent values; never invent totals.
No X-Hermes-Session-Key is sent. Add an intentional stable conversation identity, test resets/compression/memory isolation; absence does not by itself prove a memory leak.
/v1/responses supports stored context and structured tool output. Useful additional transport, not a replacement for reliable Runs.
Support image parts and bounded media rendering with provider capability checks and Android pickers/share targets. The app currently sends text and renders core Markdown only.
Current API docs reject non-image input_file/file_id. Document extraction tools on the host do not imply arbitrary mobile uploads are supported.

feature_matrix.mobile_status: Usable through configured backend; thin output UI
feature_matrix.required_work: Use server-side browser_exec/CDP and actual capabilities. Do not implement the removed browser-extension/artifact-upload protocol as the new mobile media layer.
List/detail/create/edit/pause/resume/run/delete; new jobs paused/local. Fix the prompt constraint first.

feature_matrix.mobile_status: Missing controls; preserved on other edits
feature_matrix.required_work: Current whitelist includes skills/skill, deliver, repeat and enabled; mobile edits only name/prompt/schedule. Add typed, reviewed controls and verify applied state.

feature_matrix.integration_boundary: Broader backend feature than current jobs REST whitelist
feature_matrix.required_work: Do not send unsupported keys and claim success: current bearer PATCH silently filters fields outside its whitelist. Dashboard/CLI/tool surfaces need separate contracts and consent.

feature_matrix.feature: Cron results, last_error/fire errors, stop in-flight
feature_matrix.required_work: Current DTO loses error/output/admission-recovery detail. A cron run is not automatically a tracked /v1/runs ID.
The phone task database is not a Kanban board or project work queue. Keep separate identities; add explicit remote board/project support only through verified contracts.
CLI commands are not HTTP commands. Need authorized status/control contracts and event models; agent-mediated usage is not a native management implementation.
Telegram/Slack/Discord/WhatsApp/Signal/Teams/etc. remain server adapters. Channel setup, pairing and webhook creation require separate dashboard auth and reviewed secret handling.
Do not import CLI/Desktop/messaging sessions by guessed ID. Evaluate advertised room-member grant APIs separately; Bearer and HermesRoom grants are different auth types.
Server memory/persona/context can affect normal turns already. Native selection/edit/reset and remote workspace/project choice need their actual management contracts.
No native Hermes voice/provider/audio integration; audio_api and realtime_voice are false in both audited API snapshots. Physical audio validation is still missing.
No push/device registration contract here. Add exact conversation/profile routing and job/goal events through a deliberate authenticated bridge; test background/reboot/OEM behavior.

feature_matrix.feature: Named connections and token rotation UX
feature_matrix.required_work: Atomic vault pairing exists. Add encrypted named profiles, explicit routing and tested rotation/cache policies after fixing context isolation.

feature_matrix.mobile_status: Backend execution inherited; no native manager
feature_matrix.integration_boundary: Server plugin interfaces; management contract required
feature_matrix.required_work: Keep plugin processes/providers on the host. Inventory, installation, updates and permission review require their verified management surface; there is no general plugin-admin route in the audited bearer API.

feature_matrix.mobile_status: Server capabilities, not native phone runtimes
feature_matrix.required_work: Monitor actual tool/delegation results and expose authorized status. Reimplementing these runtimes on Android is outside the companion architecture; do not count every Desktop feature as a missing phone requirement.

checks.probe_purpose: Assertions confirm current defects; not passing fixed-behavior regressions.

maintenance_recommendation: Release 1.0.1 with the four correctness fixes and desired-behavior regression tests.
Make latest supported stable a release gate; run main as a separate canary and triage additions/removals.
Add real Hermes with a deterministic model/tool fixture, minimum/current Android device CI, advisory/dependency checks and release provenance.
Use the separate dashboard management contract deliberately; do not reuse API bearer credentials or infer admin permissions.
